description.value: Peachland Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant located on Beach Avenue in Peachland. It accepts online orders for takeout, making it accessible for cyclists in the small Okanagan community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Peachland Sushi is an operational Japanese restaurant with online order capability and active business status. Website provides phone and address; the address shows a postal code discrepancy (OSM: V0H 1X7 vs website: V0H 1X4) requiring verification. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, charging) are mentioned on the website.
concerns: Address postal code discrepancy: OSM lists V0H 1X7, website shows V0H 1X4—needs manual verification
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational restaurant offering takeout service on a public street. Useful as a food resource for cycling tourists.
